changes.title: Creator swatches
items: The character creator's colours are now a grid of swatches: twelve hues and a grey column, from deep shades down to pale tints. Tap or click one to dress her (your saved witch keeps her look, moved to the nearest swatch)

changes.title: Tempo cheer
items: When you're knocked out and the party speeds up, the crowd cheers you back at your decks

changes.title: Knockdown bpm
items: Every time you're knocked down the beat speeds up by 1 BPM for the rest of the run: the music quickens and the waves come a little sooner. The tempo shows on the wave pointer and over your decks
Being knocked down again soon after no longer makes you wait longer: it's always 6 seconds
